rows.grounds: Gloss 'ka-to-sa-ending'; form kakāra-ādi-sakāra-antā suggests a bahuvrīhi compound ending in -ā (fem. agreeing form); AMBIGUOUS as exact case/number not determinable from token alone.
Gloss 'from-visarga-fivefold'; visargāt = abl.sg. of visarga, pañcadhā = adverbial 'fivefold'; compound structure AMBIGUOUS between tatpuruṣa and avyayībhāva from form alone.
Gloss 'that'; form sa = demonstrative pronoun tad, masculine nominative singular.
Gloss 'and'; form ca is an indeclinable conjunction.
Gloss 'outside-and-inside-and'; form bahis (indecl.) + anta (subst.) + ca (indecl.) compounded with -śca; membership dvandva; AMBIGUOUS as to internal case assignment from token alone.
Gloss 'in-heart'; form hṛdaye = locative singular of hṛdaya (neuter).
Gloss 'in-sound-then'; form nāde + atha appears contracted as nāde@tha; AMBIGUOUS: nāda likely loc.sg. of nāda and atha an indeclinable adverb, but sandhi boundary unclear from token alone.
Gloss 'supreme'; form parame = locative singular of parama; gender AMBIGUOUS (masculine/neuter) without syntactic context.
Gloss 'in-state'; form pade = locative singular of pada (neuter).
